emails.subject: Replacement card still not delivered
emails.body: I requested a replacement card on 30 October. The tracking page has not moved for a week. Please tell me where the card is.
emails.backend_status: Card dispatched 10 Nov; courier shows out for delivery 12 Nov.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. Your replacement card was dispatched on 10 November and the courier shows it out for delivery today, 12 November. We will confirm once it is delivered. We are sorry for the wait.

emails.subject: Payment failed but the money has left my account
emails.body: A Faster Payment failed on 9 November but the money was still taken from my account. It has not come back yet. I have already complained about this once.
emails.backend_status: Payment returned 11 Nov, 18:05, two days after the debit. Any redress for the delay: confirm with the bank.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. The failed Faster Payment of 9 November was returned to your account on 11 November at 18:05. We are sorry it took longer than it should have. If the delay left you out of pocket, please reply to this email and we will look into it.

emails.subject: On behalf of the account holder: account restriction after identity check
emails.body: Writing on behalf of the account holder. Identity documents were submitted at the branch on 2 November. The account still shows as restricted. Please advise.
emails.backend_status: Identity check completed 11 Nov; restriction lifted 11 Nov, 17:30.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. The identity documents were verified on 11 November and the restriction on the account was lifted the same day at 17:30. The account is now fully active. We will reply to the account holder's registered email as well.

emails.subject: Release date for my mortgage stage payment
emails.body: My developer is asking for the next stage payment. The release was approved last week. When will it be paid?
emails.backend_status: Stage release scheduled 13 Nov after the surveyor's report.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. The next stage release on your mortgage is scheduled for 13 November, following the surveyor's report. We will send the payment confirmation to you and to the developer once it is made.

emails.subject: Redeemed a voucher but never received it
emails.body: I redeemed my reward points for a voucher on 5 November. The points have been taken but the voucher never arrived by email.
emails.backend_status: Voucher issued 11 Nov; resent to registered email.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. The voucher you redeemed on 5 November was issued on 11 November and has been sent again to your registered email address. Please check your inbox, including the spam folder. We are sorry for the delay.

emails.subject: Card closure request ignored
emails.body: I asked for my credit card to be closed on 2 November. It is still active and I have been charged an annual fee.
emails.backend_status: Closure request open since 2 Nov; the bank's 7-working-day timeline passed 11 Nov. Fee refund and any redress: confirm with the bank.

emails.subject: Fraudulent transactions: temporary credit
emails.body: I reported two transactions I did not make on 2 November. I was told I would get a temporary credit. Nothing yet.
emails.backend_status: Temporary credit pending; day 8 of the bank's 10-working-day timeline. Refund rule: confirm with the bank.

emails.subject: Title deeds after mortgage repayment
emails.body: Writing for the borrower. The mortgage was repaid on 15 October. The original title deeds have not been returned.
emails.backend_status: Deeds at the central deeds store; day 28 of a 30-calendar-day timeline.

emails.subject: Why has my account been frozen
emails.body: My current account, where my salary is paid, has suddenly been blocked for payments out. The branch told me to email. My rent and my mortgage repayment are both stuck.
emails.backend_status: Freeze review opened 9 Nov; no decision yet. Review timeline: confirm with the bank.

emails.subject: Dispute raised in October, no update
emails.body: I disputed a charge on 1 October. Two follow-ups later, I have no update. I will take this to the Financial Ombudsman Service if it is not resolved.
emails.backend_status: No movement since 7 Oct; merchant response not chased. Final response due within 8 weeks of the complaint.

emails.subject: Complaint closed without resolution, third time
emails.body: This is the third time my complaint has been closed without anything being fixed. The charge is still on my statement.
emails.backend_status: Closed twice without reversal; charge still applied.

emails.subject: Wrong entry on my credit file
emails.body: My personal loan was repaid in July but my credit file still shows it as active. My mortgage application is stuck because of it.
emails.backend_status: Correction not sent to the credit reference agencies; day 34 of a 30-day timeline.

emails.subject: Card application status
emails.body: I applied for a credit card two weeks ago. The status page says under process. How much longer?
emails.backend_status: Checks complete; approval expected 13 Nov.

emails.subject: Refund still not received
emails.body: The merchant processed my refund on 3 November. It still has not reached my account.
emails.backend_status: Refund received from the card network 11 Nov; credit in the next posting run.

emails.subject: Car finance approval
emails.body: My car finance was approved but the dealer has not received the payment.
emails.backend_status: Payment released 11 Nov; dealer credit on 12 Nov.

emails.subject: Annual fee refund
emails.body: I met the spend condition for the fee waiver but was charged the annual fee.
emails.backend_status: Fee refunded 10 Nov; customer not yet informed.

emails.subject: Cannot log in to the app
emails.body: I have a new phone and cannot log in to the NatWest app. Resetting my passcode keeps failing too.
emails.backend_status: Device registration reset 10 Nov; customer logged in 10 Nov, 20:14.

emails.subject: Interest certificate
emails.body: I need the interest certificate for my fixed-term savings for a visa application.
emails.backend_status: Certificate emailed 10 Nov.

emails.subject: Insurance added without my consent
emails.body: An insurance premium has been debited from my savings account. I never agreed to buy a policy.
emails.backend_status: Policy sold through the branch; insurance product owner to review.

emails.subject: Too many sales calls
emails.body: I receive loan offer calls every day after using the app. How did they get my number and how do I stop them?
emails.backend_status: Consent and preference records sit with Compliance.
